rows.label: qst650614_msg0002
rows.name: I don't know how to thank you[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650614_msg0008
rows.name:
More importantly, that cargo[ML:Dash ]
It's Linka Honey, right?

rows.label: qst650614_msg0010
rows.name:
There's someone who's been
eagerly waiting for your delivery.

rows.label: qst650614_msg0011
rows.name: We'll pay you for it right here.

rows.label: qst650614_msg0012
rows.name:
Could you take it straight to
Anastasis Inn in Elmu Square
as your top priority?

rows.label: qst650614_msg0014
rows.name: I'd be delighted to do that!

rows.label: qst650614_msg0019
rows.name:
Then off you go[ML:Dash ]
And make haste.

rows.label: qst650614_msg0023
rows.name:
We still have to help Rose
meet Lazaro-san.

rows.label: qst650614_msg0025
rows.name:
M.O.M.O. and the others
should hurry, too.
